title: T011 OpenAPI v1 contract implementation
summary: T011 defines and delivers a review-ready OpenAPI 3.1 v1 contract on the post-T009 main baseline. It covers 28 paths and 35 planned operations across public reading, reader library, editorial/publisher, media, offline, provenance and optional SIWE; references the canonical ContentDocument schema, declares OIDC/BFF security, cursor pagination, Idempotency-Key, If-Match, RFC 9457 Problem Details and stable 400/401/403/404/409/422/429 examples. Independent parse/lint/example/ref proof, CI #72, Security #72 and review pass; PR #35 is merged at main@20f4f3f, authoritative read-back passes, and T011 is checked.

claims.text: Phase 1 PR #31 is merged and main@a75f1c2 confirms T001-T008 checked while T009 and T011 remain unchecked.
T011 requires a complete OpenAPI 3.1 v1 contract covering public, reader, editorial/publisher, media, taxonomy, provenance, offline and optional SIWE operations.
T011 must reference T009's canonical ContentDocument schema rather than duplicate a permissive content object.
The repaired T011 Graphify graph passes strict validation with 10 nodes, 12 edges, a complete loop registry and an L3 route for the external T009 dependency.
T009 is checked on main@70c9e71 after PR #32 implementation merge and PR #34 main read-back completion.
T011 contract implementation includes 28 paths and 35 operations from the planned API surface, including offline, provenance and optional SIWE operations.
The OpenAPI document references ./content-document.schema.json rather than duplicating a permissive content object.
Independent OpenAPI proof passes for stable error statuses, request/response examples, cursor pagination, Idempotency-Key, If-Match and security schemes.
PR #35 head 98626b8 passed CI #70, Security #70 and current-head review with zero unresolved review threads.
PR #35 merged the accepted T011 OpenAPI implementation at main@20f4f3f.
Authoritative main read-back confirms contracts/openapi.yaml, its validator, package/Makefile/CI wiring and the canonical ContentDocument ref are present; T011 is checked in tasks.md.

decision.context: Phase 1 foundation is complete, T009 is the canonical content boundary, and T011 is the next API contract slice.
decision.chosen: Implement the complete bounded OpenAPI v1 contract only after T009 canonical schema availability on main, with deterministic examples/ref/security/concurrency lint.
alternatives: Duplicate ContentDocument definitions inside OpenAPI before T009 is merged.
Use a permissive object schema and defer safety to runtime renderers.
Implement runtime endpoints or the generated client in the T011 slice.
tradeoffs: The dispatch PR is useful and auditable but does not yet deliver contracts/openapi.yaml.
T011 waits on T009, preserving a single source of truth and a resolvable local $ref.
Runtime authorization, rate limiting, audit, provider rights and generated-client parity remain later proofs.
Workflow-clean T009 reduces implementation uncertainty but does not replace the main read-back or human merge gate.
decision.invalidation: If tasks.md, the API Contract Surface plan, ADR-0003/0004, or T009 canonical schema changes, mark this record needs_update and stop before implementing T011.
decision.proof: T009 main read-back is complete. OpenAPI 3.1 independent proof passes with 28 paths, 35 operations, 17 request examples, stable Problem Details statuses/codes, cursor pagination, Idempotency-Key, If-Match, OIDC/BFF schemes and a local canonical ContentDocument ref. CI #72, Security #72 and current-head review pass with zero unresolved threads; PR #35 is merged at main@20f4f3f, authoritative main read-back passes, and T011 is checked.
